summary: Iteration 64 — verified expanded Catholic World Map (99 sites / 59 countries) with NEW 'churches under persecution' flag end-to-end + expanded vocation traditions per (vocation, state). Backend (13/13 pytest passing): GET /api/sites returns exactly 99 items across 59 countries (seed idempotent across repeat calls). Every item carries persecuted (bool) + persecution_note (string); exactly 6 sites have persecuted=true and the slugs match the spec — {our-lady-salvation-baghdad, al-tahira-qaraqosh, st-thecla-maaloula, owo-nigeria, managua-cathedral, sacred-heart-lahore}. GET /api/sites/our-lady-salvation-baghdad returns persecuted=true + non-empty persecution_note; GET /api/sites/lourdes returns persecuted=false. Accept-Language: es and it both localize persecution_note + name/history via the shared translation cache (first call cold ~20-45s, subsequent instant). GET /api/vocation/guide for vocation=marriage state=living returns exactly 11 traditions (expected: Enthrone Sacred Heart, family Rosary, liturgical year, Bless children, home altar, Chalk door at Epiphany, Angelus, holy water at door, Feast/rest Sundays, lives of saints at bedtime, Renew vows); state=discerning returns a smaller 6-item list with completely different titles. Religious life and singleness both return non-empty distinct traditions for discerning vs living. es/it localize the traditions. Account RESET to vocation=marriage state=living at end. Frontend (mobile 390x844): /community/map header shows 'Catholic World Map'; map view shows red markers for persecuted sites (Iraq/Syria/Nigeria/Lebanon visible) and the legend ScrollView includes the 'Under persecution' entry. Toggling to list view renders 'Explore 99 significant Catholic places across the world.' + exactly 99 rows; persecuted rows (e.g. Al-Tahira, Sacred Heart Lahore) display a red dot + red alert-circle icon. Tapping map-list-our-lady-salvation-baghdad opens the detail sheet with the testID=map-persecution-banner showing 'Church under persecution' heading + the full Iraq persecution note. Tapping map-list-lourdes opens a sheet with NO persecution banner (count=0). /vocation screen for marriage/living renders vocation-prayer (Morning Prayer for the Family body), 4 companions with St. Joseph default, vocation-ideas, and the nested vocation-traditions box containing all 11 expanded traditions (verified: Enthrone Sacred Heart, Bless your children, Pray the Angelus, Renew your vows present). No critical issues.
